sources_append: Angsinco-Jimenez et al., 2003; Fortes, 2013; Sanchez-Delute et al., 2025, as cited in docs/11-species.md.
transcript:
Sickle seagrass. A display, not a scan of a Mati meadow.

The buried stem grows through the sand. That is how the patch spreads.

Roots grow down at each node and spread in the sand.

Each leaf is a curved ribbon with short black bars in the blade.

The rhizome is thick, with scars between the shoots. It can flower and set seed.
